releaseNotes:
• Android 13/14+ Restricted Settings Resolution: In-app guidance card and 1-tap shortcut to FocusLock App Info to easily allow restricted settings
• Fix App Tracking After Lock Removal: Strictly halts background session tracking and scroll recording when an app's lock/protection is disabled
• Authoritative Cache Pruning: Prevents unmanaged apps from being stuck in the in-memory blocked cache
• Database State Synchronization: Automatically clears legacy stale blocked flags in Room DB when protection is toggled off
